name: DirectVoxGO
definition: A neural radiance field implementation using voxel grids for density and color features, supporting both standard dense grids and FourierGrid variants, with occupancy caching and near-camera voxel masking.
summary: DirectVoxGO is a differentiable volume rendering method that optimizes a single 3D voxel grid to represent NeRFs, solving slow convergence and high memory overhead by replacing MLP lookups with direct grid sampling.
